name: configure
note: Saves a profile and stores the API key in the OS keychain. Calls `GET /v4/organizations`; with an existing capella.yaml, also `GET …/projects` to check it (CAP-047).

name: import
note: Hidden alias of `sync` since CAP-054. Reads projects, clusters, CIDRs, buckets, scopes, schedules and credentials into capella.yaml.

name: validate
note: Offline check of schema, references and password rules.

name: plan
note: Diffs projects, clusters, deletion protection, schedules, CIDRs, buckets, scopes, collections and credentials.

name: apply
note: Same coverage as `plan`; `--prune`, `--rotate-passwords`, `--power-on` and the scale-in flags.

name: sync
note: Refreshes capella.yaml from Capella; with CAP-054 it covers every project in the organization and `import` becomes its alias.

name: destroy
note: Deletes every declared resource in reverse order; capella.yaml is kept.

name: drift
note: Read-only: changed, missing and unmanaged resources; `--detailed-exitcode`.

name: cluster disk-types
note: No API calls: disk types, sizes and IOPS from `config/disks.yaml` (Capella's documentation; the spec has only the type names).
